sources.title: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Adaptive Ultrasound-Guided Needle ...
sources.snippet: Ultrasound (US)-guided needle insertion is a critical yet challenging procedure due to dynamic imaging conditions and difficulties in needle visualization. Many methods have been proposed for automated needle insertion, but they often rely on hand-crafted pipelines with modular controllers, whose performance degrades in challenging cases.
